messages.text: Who's in for lunch at the noodle place on Witte de Withstraat today? Leaving the office at 12:15 :ramen:
In! Save me a seat, I have a call until 12:20.
Count me and two folks from sales in. That makes 6 so far.

Reminder: the final write-up for the July 14 outage is now in the engineering wiki. Thanks to everyone who helped get FleetOS back up that day. Please give it a read, especially the action items for on-call.
Thanks Marcus. Support still gets questions from customers who remember July 14, so having a link I can share is really useful.
Ops has already updated the warehouse fallback checklist based on it. AMR-200 and AMR-500 sites now have the manual mode steps printed at each dock.

Office move update :package: Movers arrive Friday afternoon. Please pack your desk into the labelled crates by Friday 14:00 and keep anything personal with you. Floor plan for the new office is pinned in #facilities.
IT note: leave monitors and docks on the desks, we will move those ourselves. Just take your laptop home over the weekend.
Is the demo AMR-500 coming with us or going to the test hall?
Test hall for now, it will join us once the new lab is set up.
Please give a warm welcome to Lena Vos, who joins the Support team today under Samuel! Lena previously worked in warehouse logistics, so she knows our customers' world well. Say hi :wave:
Welcome to Acme Robotics, Lena! Great to have you.
Welcome Lena! Coffee at 10:00, I will show you the FleetOS ticket queue afterwards.
Heads up for anyone planning a family: parental leave is now 20 weeks! :baby:
Are you sure? I haven't seen anything official about that. I'm not sure it has changed.
Good question, Tom. Please check the HR handbook or DM me before planning around any number. I'll post in #general if there's a policy update.
Reminder: laptop OS updates must be installed before the move on Friday. If yours is still pending, restart today or ping me.
